messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Hi Ripal, your order is paid and hasn't shipped yet. The B. B30 with the Power Kit ships November 7, 2026, and the whole order goes out together. Tracking comes to the email on the order as soon as it leaves the warehouse. Anything else I can check for you?
Before you go, one thing: what would make you feel kept in the loop between now and November, so you're not left checking for an update?
It’s taken a really long time since the order.. just not used to waiting this long

I hear you, Ripal, July to November is a long stretch. The delay was the cooling redesign to make the unit quieter, and we wrote to you about it on September 15 by email and text. The free Power Kit on your order was for exactly that wait, and your price is locked. Your date is November 7, and tracking comes to this email the moment it ships.
